data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.updateDownloads
data.value: Update packages Windows downloaded. Windows removes the ones it no longer needs; to clear them now, use Settings › System › Storage › Temporary files.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.componentStore
data.value: Windows' component store. Much of it is shared with System32 through hard links, so it looks bigger than it is. Only the component cleanup (DISM) can shrink it safely.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.installer
data.value: Installer files Windows needs to repair, update and uninstall your programs. Deleting them breaks uninstalling.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.temp
data.value: Temporary files of Windows and of programs running as administrator. Clear them with Settings › System › Storage › Temporary files; the folder itself must stay.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.userTemp
data.value: Your temporary files. Clear them with Settings › System › Storage › Temporary files; the folder itself must stay, and files in use are skipped there.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.deliveryOptimization
data.value: Update pieces Windows shares with other PCs. Clear them in Settings › System › Storage › Temporary files (Delivery Optimization Files).
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.errorReports
data.value: Windows error reports. Clear them in Settings › System › Storage › Temporary files.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.crashDumps
data.value: Crash dumps apps wrote when they stopped unexpectedly. Nothing needs them unless you're debugging that crash.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.packageCache
data.value: Installers kept by Visual Studio and other setup programs so they can repair and uninstall. Deleting them breaks those uninstallers.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.previousInstallation
data.value: Your previous Windows installation, kept so you can go back. Remove it with Settings › System › Storage › Temporary files (Previous Windows installation).
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.recycleBin
data.value: Items in the Recycle Bin. They use space until you empty it.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.systemVolumeInformation
data.value: Restore points and system data. Manage their space in System Properties › System Protection; never delete this folder by hand.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.hibernationFile
data.value: The hibernation file, as large as a share of your memory. Turn off hibernation with powercfg /hibernate off to remove it.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.pageFile
data.value: Virtual memory. Windows sizes it itself; change it in System Properties › Advanced › Performance.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.windows.swapFile
data.value: Swap space for Store apps, managed by Windows.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.vs.solutionCache
data.value: Visual Studio's cache for this solution: IntelliSense database and window layout. Visual Studio rebuilds it the next time it opens the solution.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.vs.solutionCacheSlnx
data.value: Visual Studio's cache for this solution: IntelliSense database and window layout. Visual Studio rebuilds it the next time it opens the solution.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.vs.installerCache
data.value: Visual Studio Installer's download cache. Turn off "Keep download cache after the installation" in the installer's settings; deleting it by hand makes repairs download again.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.dotnet.packages
data.value: Extracted NuGet packages that projects reference directly. Clear them with dotnet nuget locals global-packages --clear, then restore your projects.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.dotnet.httpCache
data.value: NuGet's download cache. NuGet downloads packages again as needed.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.dotnet.bin
data.value: Build output of this .NET project. The next build recreates it.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.dotnet.obj
data.value: Intermediate build files of this .NET project. dotnet restore and the next build recreate them.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.wsl.distributions
data.value: WSL Linux distributions and their virtual disks. Manage them in the WSL section; deleting the files loses everything installed in Linux.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.wsl.ubuntu
data.value: An Ubuntu distribution for WSL and its virtual disk. Manage it in the WSL section; deleting the folder loses everything installed in it.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.wsl.debian
data.value: A Debian distribution for WSL and its virtual disk. Manage it in the WSL section; deleting the folder loses everything installed in it.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.docker.data
data.value: Docker's virtual disks, holding every image, container and volume. Reclaim space with docker system prune; deleting the files loses all of it.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.android.gradleCaches
data.value: Gradle's download and build caches. Gradle fetches them again on the next build.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.android.gradleWrapper
data.value: Gradle versions downloaded by project wrappers. A project's wrapper downloads its version again when you build it.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.android.emulators
data.value: Android emulators. Remove them in Android Studio's Device Manager.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.android.systemImages
data.value: Android system images. Remove them in Android Studio's SDK Manager.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.android.studioCaches
data.value: Android Studio's caches, indexes and logs. It rebuilds them when you open a project; your settings live elsewhere.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.flutter.build
data.value: Flutter build output. Building the project recreates it.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.flutter.dartTool
data.value: Dart tooling state. Running flutter pub get recreates it.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.flutter.pubCache
data.value: Downloaded Dart and Flutter packages. Running flutter pub get downloads them again.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.node.modules
data.value: Installed npm packages. Running npm install restores them.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.node.next
data.value: Next.js build cache. The next build recreates it.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.node.npmCache
data.value: npm's download cache. npm refills it as you install packages.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.node.yarnCache
data.value: Yarn's package cache. Yarn downloads packages again as needed.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.node.yarnBerryCache
data.value: Yarn's package cache. Yarn downloads packages again as needed.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.node.pnpmStore
data.value: pnpm's package store, which every node_modules folder links into. Use pnpm store prune, which only removes what nothing references.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.node.bunCache
data.value: Bun's install cache. Bun downloads packages again as needed.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.node.electronCache
data.value: Downloaded Electron binaries. They are fetched again on the next install.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: cleanup.reason.node.gypCache
data.value: Node headers kept for building native modules. They are downloaded again when needed.
data.comment: Why an item has its cleanup label.

data.name: settings.refresh.label
data.value: Refresh a saved scan when it is older than
data.comment: Label of the automatic refresh setting.

data.name: settings.refresh.explanation
data.value: Temizlikci shows the last scan of a location as soon as you open it. When that scan is older than this, it reads the disk again in the background and replaces it when it's done.
data.comment: Explains the automatic refresh setting.

data.name: settings.refresh.day
data.comment: Refresh period.

data.name: settings.refresh.threeDays
data.comment: Refresh period.

data.name: settings.refresh.week
data.comment: Refresh period.

data.name: settings.refresh.never
data.comment: Refresh period meaning the app never scans by itself.

data.name: settings.admin
data.comment: Settings toggle that makes the app restart itself elevated at launch.

data.name: settings.admin.explanation
data.value: As administrator, Temizlikci reads every folder and scans NTFS drives in seconds through the Master File Table. Windows asks for permission each time the app starts. System folders stay protected either way: Temizlikci never moves them to the Recycle Bin.
data.comment: Explains the start-as-administrator setting.

data.name: settings.checkUpdates
data.comment: Settings toggle for the daily update check.

data.name: settings.checkUpdates.explanation
data.value: Once a day at most, Temizlikci asks GitHub whether a newer version is published. Nothing about this PC or its files is sent, and nothing is downloaded or installed unless you choose Download.
data.comment: Explains what the update check does and sends.
